head: ChatGPT can now read your iCloud Mail and Calendar
dek: ChatGPT now works with iCloud Mail and Calendar: find an email, catch up on your inbox, move a meeting.
details: On all plans, on the web, desktop and iPhone. You connect it with an Apple app-specific password.
where: All ChatGPT plans, if you connect them
means: If your email is on iCloud, ChatGPT can now search your inbox and move meetings for you, once you connect it.
todo: It only works after you connect it with an Apple app-specific password.
